title: Why is my 4G/5G data speed slower than expected?
content:
Question: Why is my 4G/5G data speed slower than expected?

Answer: Speed can be affected by network congestion at peak hours, device compatibility with 5G bands, distance from the tower, indoor signal attenuation, or fair-usage throttling after crossing your plan's high-speed data quota. Run a speed test under Network > Speed Test to compare against your plan's expected range.

Topic: Data Services & Speed
